title: BR-045: queue the specific_moe cross-surface scale split, and close BR-043 on merged main
intent: Documentation-only. Two things. (1) Closes BR-043 against merged main: PR #245 landed as a34b6f5d with CI 44 pass / 1 skipping / 0 fail, and the post-merge witness was taken directly on that commit -- schemas.py:165 carries `return round(c / self.density_kg_m3, 2)`, InstrumentMaterialSelector.vue:95 carries the corrected unit label, and at runtime American Basswood returns radiation_ratio 11.87 with _score_acoustic(soundboard) = 0.9924 where every species previously scored 0.0. The Dev Order permitted marking BR-043 resolved only after exactly this re-verification. (2) Promotes the deferred secondary-index finding out of BR-043's footnote into BR-045, its own queue entry: TonewoodEntry.specific_moe computes (E_GPa/rho)*1e6 == c^2/1e3 = 24265.06 for Basswood, while its own docstring claims 'Same as c^2/10^6' = 24.2651 and the client's calcSpecificMoe independently produces 24.265 -- a 1000x split in which backend code stands alone against backend docs and the client. No code changes.
behavior_change: none. No runtime file is touched. Four remediation ledger documents plus this manifest.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) REPOSITORY_DEFECT_REGISTER.md: BR-043 readiness moves from IMPLEMENTED -- AWAITING MERGE to RESOLVED, carrying a four-row post-merge witness table taken on a34b6f5d, and noting that the sole surviving 1e6 in schemas.py is specific_moe and is deliberate. The secondary-index adjudication row for specific_moe is marked promoted to BR-045. A full BR-045 entry is appended with the dimensional arithmetic, the two separable claims (docstring provably false = CONFIRMED; which side moves = not determinable), the reason it is not simply BR-043 again (no consumer contract to violate; nothing thresholds, sorts or scores on it), blast radius, the four required-before-implementation items with the owner ruling named as the blocking one, the recommended direction, and its sibling relationship to BR-044. (2) BACKLOG_ADJUDICATION_LEDGER.md: BR-043 row set to RESOLVED with the merge SHA and the 0.9924 runtime witness; BR-045 row added as OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED / code-inspection / QUEUED -- NOT AUTHORIZED, with a note explaining why that disposition rather than CONFIRMED_DEFECT. (3) REMEDIATION_DEPENDENCY_MAP.md: BR-043 -> BR-045 ordering edge; BR-044 and BR-045 recorded as siblings, not duplicates; and the shared root cause recorded once -- three instances of one failure mode, with the durable fix named as a declared unit profile per index rather than three separate scale repairs. (4) REMEDIATION_EXECUTION_QUEUE.md: BR-043 marked DONE at Wave 1 rank 7 with the merge evidence; BR-045 queued at rank 8.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: BR-043's Dev Order required merged-main re-verification before the item could be called resolved; this records that verification with a runtime witness rather than an assertion. The BR-045 promotion exists because the finding was previously a footnote inside a defect that is now closed -- the register's own rule is that queued items carry adjudication records, and a deferred cross-surface inconsistency living inside a RESOLVED entry is how items get lost. It is not a duplicate of BR-044: different metric, different failure mode, different blast radius, and BR-045 spans backend and client while BR-044 is client-local.
